opportunities.name: Movie night invite with ratings
opportunities.description: Look up a {movie} on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then email {recipient} a movie-night invite for {day} with director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer score.
steps: On IMDb, search for {movie} and open its title page
Note the director, runtime and IMDb rating
On Rotten Tomatoes, search for {movie} and open its page
Note the Tomatometer score
In mail, compose a new message to {recipient}
Set subject 'Movie night {day}: {movie}'
Write body 'Hi {name}, {day} we watch {movie} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}.'
Send or save the message

instances.values: movie=The Grand Budapest Hotel, recipient=aisha@example.com, day=Sunday (interleaved with npm research)

opportunities.name: npm package research note
opportunities.description: Look up an npm {package} on npmjs and its GitHub repo, then save a note with its version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release date.
steps: On npmjs, search for {package} and open the exact-match package page
Note the latest version, weekly downloads and license
Click the GitHub repository link
Note the stars and open issues count
Open Releases and note the latest release date
In notes, add a new note: '{package}: v{version}, {downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {issues} open issues, last release {date}'

opportunities.name: Recipe plus origin note
opportunities.description: Find a {dish} recipe on Allrecipes, look up the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a note for {servings} servings with rating, total time, the first ingredients and origin.
steps: On Allrecipes, search for {dish}
Open the top-rated matching recipe
Note the recipe title, star rating, total time and first three ingredients
On Wikipedia, search for {dish}
Note the dish's place of origin
In notes, add a new note: '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe title} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}'
